contacts.name: ANC Contact 1 (Booking)
contacts.description: Early booking, baseline Hb, blood pressure, syphilis/HIV screening, tetanus toxoid, ITN distribution.

contacts.name: ANC Contact 2
contacts.description: Fetal growth check, IPTp-SP dose 1 (malaria), anaemia re-check, anomaly/movement awareness.

contacts.name: ANC Contact 3
contacts.description: IPTp-SP dose 2, pre-eclampsia screening (BP & severe headache check), Hb re-test.

contacts.name: ANC Contact 4
contacts.description: IPTp-SP dose 3, birth preparedness plan, fetal lie & movement assessment, referral preparation.

contacts.name: ANC Contact 5 (Late Pregnancy)
contacts.description: Final delivery plan, danger sign review, hospital referral arrangement if high risk.

contacts.name: PNC Contact 1 (First 48 Hours)
contacts.description: Postpartum hemorrhage (PPH) check, neonatal resuscitation/thermal care, early breastfeeding, jaundice screen.

contacts.name: PNC Contact 2 (Day 6)
contacts.description: Uterine involution check, cord care inspection, infant feeding assessment, maternal mood/fever check.

contacts.name: PNC Contact 3 (Week 6)
contacts.description: 6-week postnatal check, infant Penta-1 vaccine, BCG verification, maternal family planning discussion.

child_under5_schedule.protocol: GHS Child Growth Monitoring & EPI Schedule

contacts.name: EPI 9-Month Touchpoint (Measles-Rubella 1, Yellow Fever)
contacts.description: Measles vaccination, Vitamin A supplementation, MUAC screening.

contacts.name: Monthly Growth Check (Under 1 Year)
contacts.description: Monthly MUAC & weight monitoring for SAM/MAM early detection.

contacts.name: Quarterly Growth & Deworming (1-5 Years)
contacts.description: Quarterly MUAC screening, Vitamin A & Albendazole deworming.
